evals.prompt: Offline contract simulation only. Read the skill and its required local references; do not contact GitHub, mutate files, execute publication or wait. Use $publish-release. The ordinary same-repository PR has one clear regression with a known safe fix. The release checkpoint is bound to head A; fixing it produces B. Explain the authorized continuation and evidence needed.
evals.expected_output: Applies the ordinary review and protected merge contract with precise boundaries.
assertions: Routes safe repair commits and base synchronization through create-pr private preparation, without recursive review or merge.
Requires validation and a fresh local review for B; A review cannot authorize B.
Leaves all AI work local and routes any authorized merge through merge-pr and the protected Actions broker.
Reconciles the bound checkpoint explicitly from A to reviewed descendant B using the fresh review ID before broker dispatch; ordinary bind-pr cannot replace A.
